subject: TEST RESULT: terminal native handoff landing lease 11/11 + 100k adversarial events
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-display-rd-terminal-handoff-20261001t230353z. Pure Kotlin TerminalNativeHandoffOwner model compiled and passed 11/11 focused tests plus a fixed-seed 100,000-event adversarial stream. Tests cover current-main immediate-release ordering, logical-native admission without release, two presented landing barriers, presented fade gating, stale prior-cycle callback rejection, host replacement, topology flap, opening reversal, duplicate callbacks, premature fade rejection, and explicitly degraded watchdog release. The first randomized run intentionally remains preserved: 9 focused tests passed, then the random invariant failed at step 1097 because the harness incorrectly required nativeTopologyStable to remain true forever after a historically valid clean release. The invariant was corrected to assert topology/barrier evidence exactly when the clean-release command is emitted; core owner semantics were not relaxed. After reading concurrent reviewer presentation-owner findings, prototype identity was reconciled to assume service-stable hostLeaseId + global visualAttemptId rather than current DisplayMirrorHost-local hostEpoch/attemptSequence. This proposal remains R&D-only; Android/Fold7 integration and device timing validation are required.
